headline: Fishermans Row, Lykos Isle Keep Strongholds in Flux
war_summary: Since the last edition, Fishermans Row remains the busiest front, with seven strategic-base changes in the past two hours and thirty on the day; Fort Ember has traded hands repeatedly, while Peripti Landing and Hangman's Court stay in the mix. Lykos Isle has stirred again, recording three flips in the last two hours, with Mārudia and Cyrus prominent. Weathered Expanse, previously a casualty sink without recorded flips, now shows four ownership events in the past day, all within the latest two-hour window at Foxcatcher and Necropolis. Tempest Island, Godcrofts, Farranac Coast, and DeadLands have quieted in the most recent windows, although their twenty-four-hour totals remain meaningful. Casualty totals continue to climb across the map; Weathered Expanse alone reports more than twenty-two thousand Colonial and twenty-four thousand Warden losses in a day, with Fishermans Row, Lykos Isle, Stlican Shelf, and Farranac Coast also heavy. On war day 119, no side has yet reached the thirty-four victory towns required for conquest.
